concerns.text: T001 instructs: 'fetches the verified CPU-score text-overlap parquet using the exact URL recorded in plan.md's verified-datasets block (the only verified source; do NOT substitute...)'. No such URL exists — plan.md's verified-datasets entry is literally blank ('is: ` (CPU-score text-overlap parquet)'). The task mandates a nonexistent input with a no-substitution clause, guaranteeing the same exit=1 failure that killed the prior T001/T002. The task list cannot preserve FR-007/SC-006 or Constitution Principle I (reproducible canonical source) without a concrete verified URL.

The FR-007 gate is circular: T001 writes 'the minimum recorded in provenance.json' and T002 checks against it — the threshold is defined by the same task that checks it, and spec.md's minimum is '[deferred]'. No task fixes a concrete, pre-registered minimum row count, so FR-007/SC-006 remain untestable as specified; a degenerate 10-row dataset would pass its own self-written gate.

Constitution Principle VII (NON-NEGOTIABLE-level framing) requires demonstrating a statistically significant 5-10% gain via visual-latent distillation on layout-dependent reasoning tasks. The task list implements the reframed structural-feature study and only 'flags a constitution amendment for kickback' (plan.md Constitution Check). An unratified amendment cannot authorize the deviation; executing T003–T012 as written violates the ratified constitution. The amendment must be ratified (or the deviation formally sanctioned) before these tasks can claim constraint preservation.

Spec acceptance criteria are silently relaxed without amendment: US-2 Scenario 1 requires MSE 'at least 5% lower than a random initialization baseline (p < 0.05)' — T005 replaces this with a frozen-random-head comparison at α=0.025 and downgrades the criterion to sanity-only; SC-003 defines success as p < 0.05 while T008 applies α = 0.025. The plan documents these as reframes pending spec amendment, but the spec has not been amended, so tasks tagged [FR-002]/[SC-003] deliver less than the spec text demands. Make the staging explicit in the spec (amend US-2 Sc.1 and SC-003) rather than in the task list.

T005 hedges the seed count ('seeds 42–44 (minimum 2 seeds; use 3 if runtime permits)') — an undeclared runtime judgment call that weakens SC-002/SC-003's statistical validity (a 2-seed paired t-test has essentially no power). Fix the seed count (and record it) in the task or spec; the power note alone does not preserve the acceptance criterion.

The leakage gate's correlation threshold is '[deferred] value set at implementation' and T007 only requires the block be 'populated with real measured values'. Whether the primary hypothesis is interpretable hinges on an unspecified threshold with no task that pre-registers or justifies it — this is a silent relaxation of the pre-registered-gate constraint stated in plan.md Phase 5. Add a task step (or T007 sub-step) that fixes and documents the threshold before evaluation runs.
